object_description: Compact square-plan volume organized around a central atrium
design_condition: Located north of the perimeter between parking, central buildings, and the hospital entrance, the compact volume forms a common entrance square while leaving reserve spaces to the south and west.

positive.statement: The building's compact volume and height give it a strong identity on the site.
The common square organizes the entrances to the new building and the hospital.
The large atrium and sequence of stairs create a generous yet intimate space.
The project is precise and coherent in its location, organization, and materialization.
It offers moments of generosity and surprising spatial qualities at its heart.
The compact building and partially opaque facades provide a sober and rational sustainable-development strategy.

negative.statement: The constrained situation limits expansion potential for both the educational building and central hospital functions.
The removal of approximately 115 parking spaces is not compensated within the project.
The building and square require the reorganization of current logistics flows.
The densification strategy creates problems of coexistence with a hospital that will constantly evolve.
The nursery benefits only from an outdoor space limited by the roads.
The planted facade containers require special attention to maintenance throughout the seasons.
The installation of blinds seems necessary despite the facade elements' solar-protection advantage.
